parameters.query:
SELECT id, n8n_workflow_id FROM automations
WHERE trigger_type = 'contact' AND trigger_event = 'created' AND is_active = true AND n8n_workflow_id IS NOT NULL;

nodes.name: Fire Automation Webhook
nodes.notes: One automation's compiled workflow failing to receive the event must not block the others from firing. alwaysOutputData also covers the zero-target case (no compiled contact-created automations exist yet) — without it, zero fan-out targets means zero items reach Respond below, and the CALLER (a contact-creation flow) would hang waiting on a response that never comes.
